item.title: Communities at Risk: The Proposed MSX Pipeline Route
item.description:
Analysis Details

This interactive map shows how communities in Mississippi are experiencing disproportionate challenges related to energy infrastructure. Our analysis looked at data from the Climate and Economic Justice Screening Tool (CEJST) and other sources to understand how communities near existing and proposed pipeline infrastructure are faring compared to others in the region.

What We Found

Communities located near pipelines and compressor stations often face a combination of health, economic, and environmental challenges. These include higher rates of chronic diseases like asthma and diabetes, greater financial strain, and increased exposure to environmental risks.

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description:
Privacy Policy

Introduction

At the Center for Science, Service, and Solidarity (CS³), we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and share information when you visit our website (scienceserves.org) or interact with us.

What Information We Collect

We primarily use GoatCounter, a privacy-focused analytics service, to understand how visitors use our website. GoatCounter collects anonymous data such as page views and referrer URLs, which helps us improve the site’s performance and content. We do not collect any personally identifiable information (PII) such as names, email addresses, or IP addresses. GoatCounter anonymizes data by truncating IP addresses to a 16-bit value.

Game Information

Step into the shoes of an environmental health investigator in ‘Metro City’! This engaging escape room activity challenges you to solve a critical case, using logic and problem-solving skills to protect the community. Inspired by real-world environmental challenges, this activity gives you a taste of what it’s like to be an environmental scientist – using science and critical thinking to solve problems and make a positive impact.
